id="trajectory-data"><div class="eyebrow">STAGE 03</div><h2>模块二：示范轨迹怎样变成仿真跟踪目标</h2><h3>设计动机</h3><p><span class="tag">论文·设计动机</span>训练WBC只需要要跟踪的末端动作，不需要在仿真里重建杯子、壶铃或投掷任务；使用真实操作轨迹让控制器面对更有代表性的动作分布。 <span class="source">§3.2 World-frame tracking · PDF页 <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=4">4</a></span></p><p><span class="tag">论文</span>本模块无独立结构原图，对应Fig.3下方仿真训练分支。WBC读取的是轨迹，不是图像；此处不能把视觉编码器连进PPO输入。</p><h3>输入 / 输出与实际处理</h3><p><span class="tag">代码</span>预处理脚本有一个待用户填写的数据计划路径；依路径条件读取两种计划结构，从中取得位置、轴角、夹爪宽度和时间戳。它对位姿左乘绕z轴−π/2的固定旋转，时间平移到零，再以名义200 Hz重采样位置和Slerp旋转。SMOOTH=False，不能因为文件里定义了滤波器就说位置平滑默认生效。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/scripts/preprocess_umi_trajs.py#L95-L170">mani-centric-wbc/scripts/preprocess_umi_trajs.py:95–170</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/scripts/preprocess_umi_trajs.py#L207-L213">mani-centric-wbc/scripts/preprocess_umi_trajs.py:207–213</a></p><p><span class="tag">未核验</span>正文未解释这一固定−π/2变换的具体标定来源；代码的np.linspace使用包含端点的样本数量，实际间隔不应在未加载数据时宣称严格等于5 ms。原始数据、处理输出与论文数据数量对应关系未在本次实际加载核验。</p><div id="code-pose_sequence-76"><p class="source">[代码] PicklePoseSequenceLoader.sample：先抽episode，再沿时间取序列 · <a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/pose_sequence.py#L76-L87">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/pose_sequence.py:76–87</a> · d75c9c182d80</p><pre><code>    def sample(self, batch_size: int, seed: int) -&gt; Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        generator = torch.Generator(device=self.device)
        generator.manual_seed(seed)
        episode_idx = torch.randint(
            0,
            self.ee_pos.shape[0],
            (batch_size,),
            device=self.device,
            generator=generator,
        )
        pos_seq = self.ee_pos[episode_idx, : self.episode_length]
        rot_mat_seq = self.ee_rot_mat[episode_idx, : self.episode_length]</code></pre></div><ol><li><span class="tag">代码</span>加载时将所有episode的ee_pos堆成E×T×3，ee_axis_angle转成E×T×3×3旋转矩阵；这里E是轨迹数，T是轨迹长度。np.stack要求可堆叠形状，不能假定任意变长原始数据可直接传入。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/pose_sequence.py#L57-L72">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/pose_sequence.py:57–72</a></li><li><span class="tag">代码</span>抽取B条episode，截到所需时长；不足时重复末帧补齐位置与旋转。B来自并行环境数量，未运行时它是配置量而非实测批次。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/pose_sequence.py#L76-L107">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/pose_sequence.py:76–107</a></li><li><span class="tag">代码</span>默认planar_center=true，用索引1、2、3三帧的xy均值做平面居中；高度随机偏移分支存在，但该sampler默认为null。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/pose_sequence.py#L108-L126">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/pose_sequence.py:108–126</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/config/env/tasks/sequence_sampler/pickle_pose_loader.yaml#L1-L7">mani-centric-wbc/config/env/tasks/sequence_sampler/pickle_pose_loader.yaml:1–7</a></li><li><span class="tag">代码</span>ReachingLinkTask.reset_idx采样并存储目标序列；step按episode_time更新当前目标。get_targets_at_times把t/dt转整数索引并裁剪到首尾，因此仿真查询是离散取样，不是每次重新做连续Slerp。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py#L577-L623">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py:577–623</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py#L652-L679">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py:652–679</a></li></ol><p><span class="tag infer">作用边界</span>这个分支解释了为何WBC能在没有任务物体的仿真中学习跟踪。它不会单凭轨迹自动学到对所有接触力的精确模型；论文的接触任务结果仍需按实验条件理解。</p></section><section id="frames"><div class="eyebrow">STAGE
